item.title: The President made a speech at a flag-raising ceremony aboard Perm nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine
item.description: The President made a speech at a flag-raising ceremony aboard Perm nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine Russia is one of the few countries capable of constructing nuclear submarines of such power, a world-class weapon of global importance. Our design bureaus and shipyards have the advanced technologies and engineering solutions, the extensive experience, and the highly qualified workforce to make it happen. A fourth-generation, Yasen-class nuclear submarine, Perm is a multi-purpose missile vessel and the first submarine to carry Zircon hypersonic cruise missiles as standard armament.

item.title: 🔹 Vladimir Putin held a meeting on the development of the Russian Navy's fleet of multipurpose nuclear submarines
item.description: Vladimir Putin held a meeting on the development of the Russian Navy's fleet of multipurpose nuclear submarines In today's environment, the Navy plays a crucial role in ensuring Russia's sovereignty and security and protecting our national interests. All its components, be it surface vessels and submarines or coastal units and infrastructure, must be ready to repel seaborne threats and possess significant firepower in order to effectively counter enemy naval groups and strike their strategic targets. In addition, the President outlined the key objectives in developing the submarine force: 🔹 modernising and expanding production capacities as well as restoring and improving critical competencies and human resources; 🔹 building new submarines of various types and, crucially, improving their weapons, primarily by consistently enhancing the performance characteristics of long-range precision weaponry and anti-ship missiles; 🔹 using the funding allocated by the government for the development of the Navy rationally via focusing on priority areas and enlisting the cooperation of small and medium high-tech companies.
item.content:encoded:

Vladimir Putin held a meeting on the development of the Russian Navy's fleet of multipurpose nuclear submarines
In today's environment, the Navy plays a crucial role in ensuring Russia's sovereignty and security and protecting our national interests. All its components, be it surface vessels and submarines or coastal units and infrastructure, must be ready to repel seaborne threats and possess significant firepower in order to effectively counter enemy naval groups and strike their strategic targets.
In addition, the President outlined the key objectives in developing the submarine force:
🔹
modernising and expanding production capacities as well as restoring and improving critical competencies and human resources;
🔹
building new submarines of various types and, crucially, improving their weapons, primarily by consistently enhancing the performance characteristics of long-range precision weaponry and anti-ship missiles;
🔹
using the funding allocated by the government for the development of the Navy rationally via focusing on priority areas and enlisting the cooperation of small and medium high-tech companies.

item.title: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes against transport infrastructure facilities and vessels
item.description: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes against transport infrastructure facilities and vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strikes, three railway locomotives used to deliver military cargo have been hit close to Pershotravensk, Kamenskoye, and Morozovskoye (Dnepropetrovsk region). 🔥 In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering dual-use cargo to support the AFU has been hit at sea south-west of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 👊 ‘We give no opportunity for enemy to advance,’ commander of artillery platoon with the call sign ‘Agro’ tells about neutralisation of enemy in Druzhkovka.

item.content:encoded:

❗️
From 21 to 27 November, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out two massive and 12 group strikes, which hit
Ukrainian defence industry enterprises used to produce cruise missiles, missile fuel, long- and medium-range UAVs, logistics centres, warehouses, power and transport infrastructure facilities used by the AFU, production workshops and storage areas of robotic systems, including UAVs, military airfields, ammunition depots, temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries.
💥
In addition,
Ukrainian port infrastructure facilities
used to receive, store, and distribute military cargo
have been disabled.
🔥
During the week,
14 dry cargo ships delivering military hardware and dual-use cargo to Ukraine to support the AFU
have been neutralised.
🚩
During the week, as a result of intensive offensive operations, units of the Sever Group of Forces established control over the settlement of Sosnovy Bor (Kharkov region).
💥
Formations of five mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades, two assault regiments of the AFU, four territorial defence brigades, and one national guard brigade
have been hit.
▪️
Over the past week, in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces, the enemy has lost more than 1,125 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 56 motor vehicles, and 25 electronic warfare and counter-fire stations.
↗️
During the week, units of the Zapad Group of Forces have taken advantageous lines and positions.
Russian elements delivered strikes at manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and two territorial defence brigades.
▪️
The AFU losses in this direction amounted to more than 1,490 troops, two tanks, five armoured fighting vehicles, 72 motor vehicles, six field artillery guns, and five electronic warfare stations.
📍
Last week, the Yuzhnaya Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted losses on formations of four mechanised brigades, one assault brigade, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades, one mountain assault brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade.
▪️
In total, in the area of responsibility of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces, the enemy has lost more than 1,145 troops, 17 armoured fighting vehicles, 132 motor vehicles, four field artillery guns, and four electronic warfare stations.
